    Latest news

    • Featured

      Healthy habits for learning

      17 June 2026

      We’ve been working with Health New Zealand on information about keeping our ākonga | students healthy to support regular school and early learning attendance.

      Find out more

    • Kia Manawaroa issue 16 out now

      25 June 2026

      Welcome to Issue 16 of Kia Manawaroa, the Ministry’s monthly newsletter for whānau Māori.

      Find out more

    • Education and Training Amendment Bill passed

      24 June 2026

      The Education and Training (System Reform) Amendment Bill passed its third reading in Parliament on 23 June.

      Find out more

    • Changes to the system for regulating the teaching workforce

      24 June 2026

      Changes to the system are being progressed after the third reading of the Education and Training (System Reform) Amendment Bill in Parliament on 23 June 2026.

      Find out more

    Have your say

    View all public consultations

    • Consultation on second group of senior secondary curriculum subjects

      openCloses: 8 July 2026

      The second group of subjects for Years 11 to 13 in the new curriculum is now available for you to review and provide your feedback.

      Find out more

    • Tertiary funding determinations

      openCloses: 17 July 2026

      We are consulting on some proposed changes to current funding determinations, including the new Tertiary Research Excellence Fund.

      Find out more

    • Consultation for 2027 tertiary fee regulation settings

      openCloses: 13 July 2026

      The Minister for Tertiary Education is consulting on tertiary fee regulation settings for 2027.

      Find out more
